title: SIDBOX CoderGirl Quick Reference and Beginner Guides
source: SIDBOX SDK headers and firmware Core (13 Oct 2026); Stage 25 IPC SDK extensions; Stage 3.23 V1 Game Engine/Advanced Platformer guides (16 Oct 2026)

SBOS_CreateWindow.summary: Create a CoderGirl GUI window. Pass a pointer to a CGWindow handle, position, size, title, and SBX_WF_* flags. Register its event procedure with SBOS_SetWindowProc().
SBOS_CreateWindow.notes: Keep the returned window handle for gadget creation and later window operations. In generated Designer applications, the window and its callback are created for you.

SBOS_CloseWindow.summary: Close the window identified by its CGWindow handle.

SBOS_SetWindowProc.summary: Install the window event procedure for GUI gadget, window, keyboard and other CGMessage_t events.
SBOS_SetWindowProc.notes: For V2 firmware, the OS invokes the callback through the applet-private stack bridge.

SBOS_WindowToFront.summary: Raise an existing window in the GUI Z-order.

SBOS_WindowToBack.summary: Move an existing window behind other normal windows.

SBOS_WindowSetFocus.summary: Give input focus to a window.

SBOS_WindowSetApplicationTitle.summary: Replace the application title shown by the window.

SetApplicationTitle.summary: Replace the application title shown by the window.

SBOS_WindowDisable.summary: Disable input interaction for a window.

WindowMouseBusy.summary: Set or query the mouse-busy indicator for an individual window.

WindowMouseIsBusy.summary: Set or query the mouse-busy indicator for an individual window.

SetMouseBusy.summary: Switch the OS pointer into busy or normal appearance.

SetMouseNormal.summary: Switch the OS pointer into busy or normal appearance.

SBX_WIN_DEFAULT.summary: Standard window flag combination: visible, moveable, titled, close/minimise/maximise controls, resizable and screen-bounded.

SBX_WF_VISIBLE.summary: Make a newly created window visible.
SBX_WF_VISIBLE.notes: Combine SBX_WF_* flags using bitwise OR (|).

SBX_WF_CLOSE.summary: Show a close control in the window title bar.

SBX_WF_MOVEABLE.summary: Allow the user to drag a window.

SBX_WF_RESIZABLE.summary: Allow the window to be resized.

SBX_WF_SCREENBOUND.summary: Constrain window movement to the physical display boundaries.

SBX_WF_ZORDER.summary: Participate in normal window Z-order behaviour.

CGMessage_t.summary: Event structure sent to the window callback. Important fields: mtype, winhnd, gadget, eventClass and event parameters a/b/c/d.
CGMessage_t.notes: The message pointer is callback-scoped; do not retain it after the callback returns.

CGWindowProcRes.summary: Return code for a window event handler. Use CGPROC_HANDLED for events you handled, CGPROC_DEFAULT for normal processing.

CGPROC_DEFAULT.summary: Return this from a window procedure to permit normal/default event handling.

CGPROC_HANDLED.summary: Return this when your application has handled the event.

CGEVT_WIN_CLOSE_REQUEST.summary: User requested that a window be closed. Handle it in the window procedure; close and free timers or other owned resources as appropriate.

CGEVT_GAD_ACTIVATED.summary: A GUI gadget has been activated (for example, a button). Compare m->gadget with your saved gadget handle.

CGEVT_GAD_SLIDERVAL_CHANGED.summary: Slider value changed. Read the slider value with SBOS_SliderGetValue().

CGEVT_GAD_CHECKBOX_CHANGED.summary: Checkbox state changed. Read it with SBOS_CheckboxGetState().

CGEVT_MENU_SELECTED.summary: A menu item was selected; configure and use the menu callback mechanism for item-specific actions.

SBOS_CreateLabel.summary: Create a text label inside a window. Give it the ACTUAL text area: too-small gadget bounds can cause partial redraws to clip text.
SBOS_CreateLabel.notes: A 1x1 rectangle for a full-width label is not sufficient when overlapping windows trigger dirty-region repainting.

SBOS_CreateButton.summary: Create a clickable button gadget in the specified window.

SBOS_CreateCheckbox.summary: Create a checkbox with an initial checked state.

SBOS_CreateRadioButton.summary: Create a radio button with group number and initial checked state.

SBOS_CreateSlider.summary: Create a slider using orientation and minimum/maximum values.

SBOS_CreateScrollbar.summary: Create a scrollbar with orientation, value range and small/large step sizes.

SBOS_CreateTextBox.summary: Create a single-line text-editing gadget. tb_flags chooses textbox behaviour.

SBOS_CreateTextArea.summary: Create a multi-line text area for longer editable text.

SBOS_CreateProgBar.summary: Create a progress bar to display progress between configured minimum and maximum.

SBOS_CreateBitmapView.summary: Create a rectangular bitmap-view gadget with an image size and bitmap-view flags.

SBOS_CreateCanvas.summary: Create a canvas gadget for application-drawn graphics.

SBOS_CreateGridSelect.summary: Create a grid selector with specified cell dimensions and counts.
